nom: Banila Co Snoopy Edition Clean it Zero Original Cleansing Balm

avis.titre: Cleans my skin without feeling harsh
avis.texte: The balm cleanser has been so helpful for cleaning my dry winter skin without leaving my face super dry afterwards. It comes packaged with a mini spatula, so it makes it easy to scoop out what you need (more on makeup days, less when bare skin) and it prevents it from getting underneath my long nails. I already own a spatula for face masks, but this scoop is smaller and better for measuring the product. I got this Snoopy collab version on sale, and it came with a cute little Snoopy keychain and mini mirror which I use to make sure my teeth are clean and lippy hasn’t smeared after eating. I am already planning on rebuying once I use up this jar, though probably the regular version or a different collab than the Snoopy.

avis.titre: Must have in my beauty ritual
avis.texte: This is my favorite makeup remover! The balm will remove any makeup and it doesn't leave a filmy residue. I do cleanse my face after. No scent and the application is easy. My skin feels soft afterwards. The snoopy charm is so cute!!!
Great product!! Love love it. Nice scent and leaves your face very soft.! I’m a fan😊 This is as good as the best by far!
I love this product for everyday use. Having the Peanuts characters was a cool addition to a product I already loved. Super facial cleanser. Very effective.
I like this but it isn’t “Yuka” approved so I will find something else
I love this cleansing balm. I’ve repurchased many times. Gets everything off and does not have any smell. Lasts a long time beside you don’t need a lot.

avis.titre: Great face cleansing balm and bonus for the Snoopy fans
avis.texte: Daughter has used the product for a few years, really likes how well it removes her makeup. She also loves Snoopy, so this was a bonus. Came with a cute Snoopy keychain. She says the texture is gentle on her skin and leaves it feeling clean.
La empecé a usar y es muy buena retira bien el maquillaje, aparte que si te gusta snoopy como ami te va encantar más

avis.titre: Soothing cleansing balm appropriate for all ages and sensitive skin
avis.texte: This cleansing balm has quickly become a skincare staple for my sensitive skin, even when it's distressed. This cleansing balm is so mild and gentle that it's a keeper for all age groups. It cuts through makeup and heavy barrier creams, but it's also gentle enough to use AM and PM. This large jar is also a generous size (over 6 fl oz!) for the price, and with a quality product like this, you don't need a lot of product to be effective. My skin tolerates a lot, but it has its limits. When my sensitive skin becomes aggravated, getting it back to baseline is not a simple task. My aggravated skin is easier to aggravate further than to soothe back to baseline. The products that soothed my skin for months can become antagonistic overnight. One of my relentless stressors is when I must be outside in the cold for several hours during the winter, which happens when we get a lot of snow. After hours in the windy, icy weather, even my best barrier creams have not prevailed and my skin is distressed. This cleansing balm is more soothing than even my hypoallergenic, Ph neutral, "gentle as water" face soap. I also love that it comes with an applicator for removing this balm from its jar. It glides onto my skin, produces no suds, and rinses off cleanly. I can use it even on my skin when it's chapped, and it's the first product that I know I can use that will not worsen that situation. avis.titre: Love this Snoopy edition of the classic K-beauty makeup removing balm!
avis.texte: I have been having great results lately with Korean skincare, so I was excited to try the classic and much loved Banila Co Clean it Zero Original Cleansing Balm Snoopy Edition! First, the packaging is so cute, with Charlie Brown and Snoopy on the pink container, and it comes with a keychain with a mirror and a Snoopy figurine holding Woodstock (his yellow bird companion.) It’s adorable and a sure hit with any Snoopy fan or dog lover. The balm itself was a new experience for me. It’s a waxy solid that you scoop up with the included tiny spatula, and it melts into a milky cleanser when mixed with water on your skin. It has a mild, pleasant scent. It does not lather too much, but it removes makeup and sunscreen and leaves skin feeling smooth and hydrated without stripping or drying. Most people use it as a makeup remover and the first step in a double cleansing routine, which is what I chose to do, because while it did a great job of removing my tinted serum and sunscreen, my face didn’t feel as completely clean as usual without using an additional cleanser afterward. But it’s a great alternative to makeup remover wipes and micellar water with additional skin care benefits. This one has Acerola berry and vitamin C, but there are at least 7 varieties now of the Banila Cleansing Balm to suit any skin type or concern. I really do like this classic K-beauty cleansing balm! avis.titre: A favorite cleansing balm with adorable Snoopy packaging
avis.texte: Banila’s cleansing balm is ridiculously popular and it’s been a favorite many of years now. If you’ve never used it, it’s a solid white colored balm that melts onto the skin, dissolves everything from makeup to sunscreen to thick oily skincare products with ease and once rinsed off leaves the skin soft. Even dry skin like mine! It’s simple and easy to use too. I don’t know why but for some reason I’m just more comfortable using a balm and rinsing than using a really foamy cleanser. I think I’m part cat and just appreciate the process of the balm more. Oh, and the ingredients are great. It’s a quality product that contains no fragrance and should be well tolerated. And since so little is needed the large tub with last for a long time. It’s a small investment to make given how long it’ll last. What you’re getting here is one of the most popular cleansing balms with cute Snoopy packaging. It might look cute but it’s really good skincare. It comes with a little Snoopy keychain with a mirror too for added fun. It also comes with a little spatula to scoop the balm out of the jar so don’t forget to look in the bottom of the box. It’s a much loved balm at a reasonable price and would make a great gift for the upcoming holidays.

avis.titre: Makeup slides off, skin stays soft
avis.texte: I’ve been using this as step 1 at night for years, before my cleanser, to take off a full face after long days. I wanted something that melts makeup fast without tugging. The balm has that hard coconut oil feel that turns from a solid to a light oil when warmed between fingers. It spreads easily over dry skin and breaks down foundation, SPF, and long-wear lip color in seconds. A little goes a long way and it doesn’t feel heavy while you work it in. With water it loosens up and wipes away clean with a washcloth, then my second cleanser takes care of the rest. No film, no tightness, and my skin feels cushioned and hydrated afterward. The jar is wide enough to scoop without mess, and the included spatula is handy for keeping things tidy. The Snoopy edition is cute, and it includes a little keychain, but performance is what stands out. Value is solid for how well it removes makeup and how soft my skin feels after. I recommend it to anyone who double cleanses or wears makeup daily and wants an easy first cleanse that leaves skin comfortable.

The BANILA CO Clean It Zero Original Cleansing Balm Snoopy Edition is a cute, collectible twist on a cult-favorite cleanser — and it performs just as well as the original. The balm has a soft, sherbet-like texture that melts instantly on contact, breaking down makeup, sunscreen, and excess oil without tugging or leaving any residue. It removes even long-wear foundation and waterproof mascara effortlessly. The formula is vegan, gentle, and suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. It rinses off cleanly with no film, leaving the skin soft, balanced, and ready for a second cleanse. There’s no heavy fragrance, and it doesn’t cause irritation or clogged pores. The Snoopy Edition packaging is adorable and makes the product feel special, especially with the exclusive keychain included. It’s a fun bonus for collectors or anyone who loves Peanuts characters. Overall, this cleansing balm delivers the same reliable performance BANILA CO is known for, with a cute limited-edition touch. Effective, gentle, and aesthetically charming — a great pick for daily makeup removal, great size and easy to apply!
As cleansing balm this works wonderfully but the (Peanuts special edition) product isn’t quite as listed: item specs say 180ml, but it is 100 ml.

avis.titre: Literally melted my makeup off and the snoopy keychain is super cute too!
avis.texte: I'm normally fairly apprehensive about balms that then melt into a sort of 'oil' on the skin, but after seeing that this one was both vegan and had great reviews for all skin types, I decided to give it a test on the powder foundation that I use daily without much other make up. I was so pleasantly surprised to see that BANILA really does fill up their containers almost to the top with product, which always makes it feel like a GREAT value. The balm on my fingers wasn't as drying as I worried it might be, and it did wonders to quickly have my makeup ready to be just wiped off. It's a fairly big pot of cleansing balm, and I only used a little and it went such a long way! The quality was great, too, and I wasn't left feeling immediately oily or dried out as I normally do with products like this. Very excited to keep using!

avis.titre: Effective makeup-removing cleansing balm with fun Snoopy keychain—great first step
avis.texte: This cleansing balm is an interesting addition to my routine. While I wouldn't replace my daily cleanser, it works wonderfully as a first step to remove makeup—likely its intended use, despite being marketed as a general cleanser that can remove makeup. The thick balm applies easily with the included spatula, emulsifies well with water, and rinses cleanly. My skin feels thoroughly cleansed, and makeup—especially stubborn products—comes off effortlessly. I follow up with my acne-control cleanser for a complete wash. A fun bonus is the included Snoopy keychain with a tiny mirror, a nice touch for collectors or gift-giving. It adds charm without compromising function. For those looking for an effective, enjoyable makeup-melting balm, this delivers—especially as part of a double-cleansing routine.

This balm is awesome for makeup removal! It’s a large size jar that looks like wax but it melts like butter in your hands! My makeup came off quick and effortlessly, it didn’t burn my eyes, it rinsed off without leaving any residue and it left my skin feeling soft and not stripped of moisture! It doesn’t take much so this jar should last a good while depending on usage. It’s simple and easy to use, just rub it on and it immediately begins to break down the make up. I was done cleaning my face within a few minutes. Overall, I love this product and will be exploring other skin care options from this line!

avis.titre: This new cleanser is now part of my daily skincare routine
avis.texte: I haven't used anything like this so I was intrigued and had to be sure to read instructions. Most facial cleansers are done with water but this one would be applied from a different looking bottle where you scoop up the cleanser cream and apply it to dry skin (not wet). The scent is good, like just a skincare type of smell that is refreshing and clean. It went on very smooth and actually removed my makeup. Eyeliner is always hard to remove but after applying some water to the mix, it activates the oil and the oil is what gets all the impurities of your skin removed easily. My skin isn't really sensitive so I had no skin irritation effects. The quality of the label design and bottle is adorable of course. This is a snoopy version and came with a keychain mirror free! This is a nice package and would make a great gift.

I have seen this brand before, and from what I remember, they specialize in all types of cleansing balms. This one has a delightfully fruity scent, and it comes with a little spatula and a plastic lid to separate and seal the product away from air. The balm melted onto my skin and literally washed every speck of make up I was wearing completely off. 5 stars for effectiveness, another 5 for scent, and 5 more for the bonus keychain. The jar is much larger than I was expecting and I think it's going to take me a fair amount of time to run through this. I'm so glad it doesn't have one of those dumb swivel-to-dispense lids, yuck, so unsanitary. This is much better.

I purchased this, BANILA CO Clean it Zero Original Cleansing Balm Snoopy Edition | Korean Makeup Remover with Exclusive Keychain | Facial Cleanser for All Skin Types | Vegan Formula (100ml / 3.38 fl. oz). Firstly, it's Snoopy! What could be cuter? Secondly, this works so well! The container comes with a peel off seal. You get a clear cap to cover the balm and an included scoop. The balm has just a tiny hint of scent-very light, pleasant. This feels like a smooth body butter! Balm is lightweight and melts easily as it is rubbed on. After applying and rubbing across the face, add a little water, keep rubbing, then simply rinse off with wster-no soap needed. My face feels super clean and soft afterwards! This size is good and should last about a month if used once daily. The pink container color is super pretty. The Snoopy keychain or purse charm is adorable. This is a good value for the quality and usefulness.

This stuff really works great at removing my makeup at night. It comes with a scooper to rub on your skin. I'll get a wet washcloth and rub it into my face and eyes then rinse off. Has a nice smell and isn't too greasy. You'll get a lot of cream, good value for the price and size of the jar. Helps keep my skin feeling moisturized. I highly recommend.
